headline: Wednesday, Nov 25. Softest people-day of the week; dry through Sunday morning, big storm Monday night.

items: Wed 61/48 partly sunny, dry after a leftover drizzle early
Thu (Thanksgiving) 60/47 cloudy, dry - travel day is clean
Fri 55/47 cloudy, dry - Sat 56/48 partly sunny, dry
Sun 59/51 light rain (40%), S gusts near 20 mph
Mon 63/55 by day, then the big one Monday NIGHT: 85% heavy rain, over an inch
That storm lands the night before your Granite start Monday - plan a wet first commute
Today hourly: 49F at 5am with leftover drizzle, clearing by 9, high 58 at 2-4pm, dry evening, wind under 5 mph

sections.lead: Today is a four-way love letter to Venus: your warmth, your people, your get-along energy all lit at once, the softest sky of your week, landing right on Thanksgiving eve.
items: Use it: gratitude texts, kind words, reconnecting before the holiday
One watch-out: Mercury still squares your natal Mars and opposes your Ascendant, so words can carry an edge
How to use it: say the kind thing today, and read anything sharp once more before it goes - including the 1pm letter
sections.body: Details: Venus conj natal Moon 0.2 deg, Sun trine natal Venus 1.1, Neptune R trine natal Venus 0.8, Uranus R sextile natal Venus 3.5. Moon waning gibbous Gemini 16.2, 99% lit, sextile natal Mars 0.4. Mercury square natal Mars 1.6, opp natal Asc 2.3. Jupiter sextile natal Moon 2.8. Saturn R trine natal Sun 2.0. One-line read: warm heart, kind words, double-check the sharp ones.
